email.subject: Re: Pallasine checklist, from July 6
email.body:
Wren Duskfield said on July 6, in the Onboarding Process: Pallasine Checklist conversation you saved: "Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first week: accounts, pairing rotation, and a shadow shift. It replaced the old wiki page last quarter."

So now the first week is a standing checklist for every new hire: accounts, pairing rotation, and the shadowing step, all inside that week. The old wiki page is no longer where onboarding is sent, since the checklist took its place last quarter.

My read is that the checklist is a requirement rather than a suggestion, so each new hire's first week can be planned against all three parts. That suggests the old wiki page no longer needs upkeep or pointing people to. If that holds, the accounts setup and the shadowing are fixed scope, not optional extras a manager can drop. Wren's words are the only ones on this so far, so it may be worth confirming the checklist with her before it goes into a hiring plan.

Two questions it leaves open: does the same checklist hold for contractors and short-term hires, and how is the shadowing scheduled when a whole cohort starts together?

The conversation, with everyone's words: https://dev.api.aswritten.ai/live/conversation/2026-10-13-2-forget-lifecycle-bystander
